findings.evidence: When included in collab/tests/tmux_recv_e2e.rs, support/tmux_cli_fixture.rs triggers compiler warnings for unused imports (BufReader, Read, Write, TcpStream) and unused functions (single_pane_fixture, assert_no_secret_surface, assert_context_display_is_public) because those helpers are only consumed by tmux_master_authority_cli.rs.
findings.remediation: Add #[allow(dead_code, unused_imports)] at the top of support/tmux_cli_fixture.rs or gate unused items so that both test targets compile with zero warnings.
